question.en:
A company wants to migrate unstructured data to AWS. The data needs to be securely moved with inflight encryption and end-to-end data validation.

Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
question.ja:
ある企業は、非構造化データをAWSに移行したいと考えています。このデータは、通信中の暗号化とエンドツーエンドのデータ検証を伴って安全に移動される必要があります。

この要件を満たすAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: C. AWS DataSync AWS DataSync is a service designed for securely transferring large amounts of data between on-premises storage and Amazon S3, Amazon EFS, or Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. It supports in-flight encryption and end-to-end data validation during the transfer process. In the context of the question, AWS DataSync is a suitable choice for securely moving unstructured data to AWS while ensuring encryption and data integrity throughout the migration process. Therefore, option C, AWS DataSync, would meet the specified requirements.

A: AWS Application Migration Service Used for migrating servers and applications, not for transferring unstructured data. B: Amazon EFS –Provides scalable file storage but does not handle data migration or transfer C: AWS DataSync it is designed to securely move large amounts of data, including unstructured data, with in-transit encryption and end-to-end data validation. D: AWS Migration Hub Tracks migration progress but does not handle the actual data transfer.
https://aws.amazon.com/datasync/ Securely discover and migrate your data to AWS with end-to-end security, including data encryption and data integrity validation.
C. AWS DataSync
https://aws.amazon.com/datasync/#:~:text=replication%20or%20archival.-,How%20it%20works,-Transfer%20data%20between
Answer is C.
C: AWS Datasync
AWS DataSync is a service designed for securely transferring large amounts of data between on-premises data storage systems and Amazon S3, Amazon EFS, or Amazon FSx for Windows File Server.
C is the correct answer Migrate your data Quickly move file and object data to AWS. Your data is secure with in-flight encryption and end-to-end data validation.

explanation.ja: 正解はC。AWS DataSyncはオンプレミスとAWS間で非構造化データを転送する際、通信中の暗号化とエンドツーエンドのデータ整合性検証を標準で提供する。AWS Application Migration Serviceはサーバー移行、Amazon EFSはファイルストレージそのもの、AWS Migration Hubは移行状況の追跡ツールであり、安全なデータ転送機能そのものはDataSyncが担う。

question.en:
A development team wants to deploy multiple test environments for an application in a fast, repeatable manner.

Which AWS service should the team use?
question.ja:
ある開発チームは、あるアプリケーションのために複数のテスト環境を迅速かつ再現可能な方法でデプロイしたいと考えています。

チームが使用すべきAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: B is the correct answer. Explanation: AWS CloudFormation is used for infrastructure as code (IaC), allowing users to define and deploy AWS resources in a repeatable and automated manner.

Answer is B: Cloudformation. https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/development-and-test-on-aws/testing-phase.html Provisioning complete environments While you can create complex test environments containing multiple instances using the AWS APIs, command line tools, or the AWS Management Console, AWS CloudFormation makes it even easier to create a collection of related AWS resources and provision them in an orderly and predictable fashion. AWS CloudFormation uses templates to create and delete a collection of resources together as a single unit (a stack). A complete test environment running on AWS can be described in a template, which is a text file in JSON or YAML format.
https://aws.amazon.com/cloudformation/faqs/#:~:text=AWS%20CloudFormation%20is%20designed%20to,resources%20across%20accounts%20and%20regions.
Answer is B. CloudFormation will allow you to use infrastructure as code and allow you to repeat deployments fast and always be the same.
i believe option A - EC2 would require more operational overheard, thus making it less efficient
the anser is B
CloudFormation
IAC CLOUDFORMATION
B : Cloud Formation

explanation.ja: 正解はB。AWS CloudFormationはテンプレートを使い、同一構成の環境を迅速かつ再現可能にデプロイできる。Amazon EC2は個別リソースの起動のみ、Amazon QuickSightはBIツール、Amazon ECSはコンテナオーケストレーションであり、複数環境の再現可能なデプロイという要件にはCloudFormationが適する。

question.en:
A company wants to quickly implement a continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.

Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
question.ja:
ある企業は、継続的インテグレーション/継続的デリバリー(CI/CD)パイプラインを迅速に実装したいと考えています。

この要件を満たすAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: https://aws.amazon.com/codestar/ Discontinuation of AWS CodeStar support On July 31, 2024, Amazon Web Services (AWS) will discontinue support for creating and viewing AWS CodeStar projects. After July 31, 2024, you will no longer be able to access the AWS CodeStar console or create new projects. However, the AWS resources created by AWS CodeStar, including your source repositories, pipelines, and builds, will be unaffected by this change and will continue to function. AWS CodeStar Connections will not be impacted by this discontinuation. If you wish to track work, develop code, and build, test, and deploy your applications, Amazon CodeCatalyst provides a streamlined getting started process and additional functionality to manage your software projects. Learn more about functionality and pricing of Amazon CodeCatalyst.
AWS CodeStar accelerates software release with the help of AWS CodePipeline, a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) service. https://aws.amazon.com/codestar/features/

AWS CodeStar is a fully managed service that makes it easy to develop, build, and deploy applications on AWS. It provides a unified user interface, pre-configured project templates, and integration with other AWS services to set up a CI/CD pipeline quickly.

D is the correct answer AWS CodeStar is a cloud‑based development service that provides the tools you need to quickly develop, build, and deploy applications on AWS. With AWS CodeStar, you can set up your entire continuous delivery toolchain in minutes, allowing you to start releasing code faster.

D. AWS CodeStar Explanation: AWS CodeStar is a managed service specifically designed to enable quick implementation of a continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline. It provides a unified user interface to set up, manage, and collaborate on software development projects.
D. AWS CodeStar
D is the correct answer.
D : Codestar

explanation.ja: 正解はD。AWS CodeStarは、CodeCommit、CodeBuild、CodeDeploy、CodePipelineなどを組み合わせたCI/CDパイプラインをテンプレートから迅速に構築できるサービス。AWS Configは構成管理、Amazon Cognitoはユーザー認証、AWS DataSyncはデータ転送であり、CI/CDパイプラインの迅速な実装には向かない。

question.en: Which AWS service or feature gives users the ability to capture information about network traffic in a VPC?
question.ja: VPC内のネットワークトラフィックに関する情報をユーザーが取得できるようにするAWSサービスまたは機能はどれですか?

comment.en: VPC Flow Logs is a feature that enables you to capture information about the IP traffic going to and from network interfaces in your VPC. https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html
A is correct answer

A: VPC Flow Logs – this feature captures information about IP traffic going to and from network interfaces in a VPC B: Amazon Inspector – Scans for vulnerabilities and security issues, but doesn’t capture network traffic. C: VPC route tables – Define routing rules but don’t log or capture traffic. D: AWS CloudTrail – Logs API activity, not network-level traffic.
A. VPC Flow Logs

explanation.ja: 正解はA。VPC Flow LogsはVPC内のネットワークインターフェースを通過するトラフィックの情報を記録する。Amazon Inspectorは脆弱性診断、VPCルートテーブルは経路制御の設定情報、AWS CloudTrailはAPI操作ログであり、トラフィック自体の情報取得にはVPC Flow Logsが適する。

question.en: Which type of AWS storage is ephemeral and is deleted when an Amazon EC2 instance is stopped or terminated?
question.ja: 一時的で、Amazon EC2インスタンスが停止または終了すると削除されるAWSストレージの種類はどれですか?

text.ja: Amazon EC2インスタンスストア

comment.en: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/InstanceStorage.html

B Amazon EC2 instance store provides temporary block-level storage that is directly attached to the Amazon EC2 instance. It is referred to as "ephemeral" because the data stored in the instance store volumes is not persistent and is deleted when the EC2 instance is stopped or terminated.
Letterman B
Pretty sure, B
An instance store provides temporary block-level storage for your instance. https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/InstanceStorage.html

- The instance store is temporary storage. Data that's stored in instance store volumes isn't persistent through instance stops, terminations, or hardware failures. - EBS volumes preserve their data through instance stops and terminations.
B. Amazon EC2 Instance Store

explanation.ja: 正解はB。EC2インスタンスストアはホストマシンに直結された一時的なストレージで、インスタンスの停止・終了とともにデータが失われる。Amazon EBSはネットワーク接続型で永続化され、Amazon EFSとAmazon S3もインスタンスのライフサイクルと独立して永続化されるストレージである。

question.en:
A company wants to provide access to Windows file shares in AWS from its on-premises workloads. The company does not want to provision any additional infrastructure or applications in its data center.

Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
question.ja:
ある企業は、オンプレミスのワークロードからAWS上のWindowsファイル共有へのアクセスを提供したいと考えています。この企業は、自社のデータセンターに追加のインフラストラクチャやアプリケーションをプロビジョニングしたくありません。

この要件を満たすAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: https://aws.amazon.com/fsx/windows/ https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/storage/accessing-your-file-workloads-from-on-premises-with-file-gateway/
Amazon FSx File Gateway optimizes on-premises access to fully managed, highly reliable file shares in Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. https://aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/file/fsx/
FSx File Gateway -> File sharing for Windows using SMB protocol DataSync -> Transfer S3 -> Storage Snow Family -> Migration

A FSX seems a correct option. but please find more about it. Amazon FSx File Gateway optimizes on-premises access to fully managed, highly reliable file shares in Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. Customers with unstructured or file data, whether from SMB-based group shares, or business applications, may require on-premises access to meet low-latency requirements. Amazon FSx File Gateway helps accelerate your file-based storage migration to the cloud to enable faster performance, improved data protection, and reduced cost.

Amazon FSx File Gateway is a service that enables on-premises access to file data stored in Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. It allows you to access Amazon FSx file shares from your on-premises workloads without provisioning additional infrastructure or applications in your data center.
A. Amazon FSx File Gateway

explanation.ja: 正解はA。Amazon FSx File GatewayはSMBプロトコルでオンプレミスからAWS上のAmazon FSx for Windows File Serverへアクセスでき、オンプレミス側に追加インフラを構築せずにキャッシュ経由でファイル共有できる。AWS DataSyncはデータ転送、Amazon S3はオブジェクトストレージでSMB非対応、AWS Snow Familyはデータ移行用デバイスであり、継続的なファイル共有アクセスには向かない。

question.en:
A company wants durable storage for static content and infinitely scalable data storage infrastructure at the lowest cost.

Which AWS service should the company choose?
question.ja:
ある企業は、静的コンテンツ向けの耐久性のあるストレージと、最も低いコストで無限にスケール可能なデータストレージインフラストラクチャを求めています。

企業が選ぶべきAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: S3 is a correct answer Amazon S3 is object storage built to store and retrieve any amount of data from anywhere. S3 is a simple storage service that offers industry leading durability, availability, performance, security, and virtually unlimited scalability at very low costs.

Amazon S3 (Simple Storage Service) is a fully managed object storage service that provides durable storage for static content. It is designed for scalability, high availability, and low-latency access to store and retrieve any amount of data.
Amazon S3
Absolutely B
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html
Answer : B. Amazon S3

explanation.ja: 正解はB。Amazon S3は静的コンテンツ向けに高い耐久性（イレブンナイン）を持ち、事実上無制限にスケールする最も低コストのオブジェクトストレージ。Amazon EBSはインスタンス単位のブロックストレージ、AWS Storage Gatewayはハイブリッド接続サービス、Amazon EFSはファイルストレージであり、静的コンテンツの大規模・低コスト保存にはS3が最適。

question.en:
A company wants to transform its workforce by attracting and developing a digitally fluent high-performance workforce. The company wants to attract a diverse and inclusive workforce with appropriate mix of technical and non-technical skills.

Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) perspective will meet these requirements?
question.ja:
ある企業は、デジタルに精通した高パフォーマンスの人材を惹きつけ育成することで、自社の労働力を変革したいと考えています。この企業は、技術的スキルと非技術的スキルを適切に組み合わせた、多様で包摂的な人材を惹きつけたいと考えています。

この要件を満たすAWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) の視点はどれですか?

comment.en: Key word: diverse*

B. People The AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) has several perspectives, and the "People" perspective is focused on workforce transformation, including attracting and developing a digitally fluent high-performance workforce. This perspective emphasizes the importance of organizational culture, skills development, and creating a diverse and inclusive workforce with the right mix of technical and non-technical skills.

CAF > People > Workforce transformation – To succeed in your cloud transformation, take a proactive approach to talent enablement planning beyond traditional HR to include C-suite leadership, and modernize your approaches to leadership, learning, rewards, inclusion, performance management, career mobility, and hiring. You will need a diverse and inclusive workforce with the appropriate mix of technical and non-technical skills. Identify gaps in roles and skills across your entire organization and develop a workforce strategy that will improve your organizational cloud capability.
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/people-perspective.html please help discussing on 314. Many Thanks.
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/people-perspective.html
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-people-perspective/aws-caf-people-perspective.html

explanation.ja: 正解はB。AWS CAFの「人材（People）」視点は、組織文化の変革やスキル育成、多様で包摂的な人材の獲得・育成を扱う。ビジネス視点は成果創出、プラットフォーム視点は技術基盤、オペレーション視点は日常運用を扱う視点であり、人材の惹きつけ・育成とは異なる。

question.en:
A company needs a fully managed file server that natively supports Microsoft workloads and file systems. The file server must also support the SMB protocol.

Which AWS service should the company use to meet these requirements?
question.ja:
ある企業は、Microsoftのワークロードとファイルシステムをネイティブにサポートするフルマネージドのファイルサーバーを必要としています。このファイルサーバーはSMBプロトコルもサポートする必要があります。

この要件を満たすために企業が使用すべきAWSサービスはどれですか?

text.en: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
text.ja: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

comment.en: https://aws.amazon.com/fsx/windows/

C. Amazon FSx for Windows File Server Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is the AWS service that provides a fully managed file server that natively supports Microsoft workloads and file systems. It is built on Windows Server and supports the Server Message Block (SMB) protocol, making it suitable for seamlessly integrating with Microsoft applications and workloads.
Provide highly available, high performance storage to your Windows applications with full SMB support. https://aws.amazon.com/fsx/windows/

explanation.ja: 正解はC。Amazon FSx for Windows File ServerはMicrosoftのネイティブファイルシステム機能（Active Directory統合、NTFS等）とSMBプロトコルをフルマネージドで提供する。Amazon EFSはLinux向けNFSファイルシステム、Amazon FSx for LustreはHPC向け、Amazon EBSはブロックストレージであり、Windowsワークロード向けファイルサーバーにはFSx for Windows File Serverが適する。

question.en:
A company has been storing monthly reports in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company exports the report data into comma-separated values (.csv) files. A developer wants to write a simple query that can read all of these files and generate a summary report.

Which AWS service or feature should the developer use to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?
question.ja:
ある企業は、月次レポートをAmazon S3バケットに保存しています。この企業は、レポートデータをカンマ区切り値(.csv)ファイルにエクスポートしています。ある開発者は、これらすべてのファイルを読み込み、サマリーレポートを生成できるシンプルなクエリを書きたいと考えています。

運用オーバーヘッドを最小限に抑えてこの要件を満たすために開発者が使用すべきAWSサービスまたは機能はどれですか?

comment.en: B. Amazon Athena Amazon Athena is a serverless query service that allows you to analyze data directly in Amazon S3 using SQL queries. It supports a variety of file formats, including comma-separated values (.csv). With Athena, the developer can write SQL queries to read the .csv files stored in the Amazon S3 bucket and generate the desired summary report without the need to provision or manage infrastructure.

question.en: Which AWS feature provides a no-cost platform for AWS users to join community groups, ask questions, find answers, and read community-generated articles about best practices?
question.ja: AWSユーザーがコミュニティグループに参加し、質問し、回答を見つけ、ベストプラクティスに関するコミュニティ生成の記事を読むための無料のプラットフォームを提供するAWSの機能はどれですか?

comment.en: B. AWS re:Post AWS re:Post is a no-cost platform that provides AWS users with a community space to ask questions, find answers, and engage with other users. Users can join community groups, participate in discussions, and read community-generated articles about best practices. It is a part of the AWS Community and allows users to share knowledge and experiences. The other options are not specifically associated with a community platform.

B. AWS re:Post AWS re:Post is a community-driven platform where users can engage with the AWS community, ask questions, share knowledge, and learn from others. It is a part of the AWS Community Forums, which is a valuable resource for getting assistance and insights from other AWS users and experts.

A: AWS Knowledge Center – Provides how-to articles from AWS, but it's not a community-driven platform. B: AWS re:Post it's a no-cost, community-driven Q&A platform where AWS users can ask questions, share answers, and read community-generated best practices. C: AWS IQ – Connects customers with AWS-certified freelancers for paid expert help, not a free community platform. D: AWS Enterprise Support – Paid support tier offering technical assistance, not a public community platform.
the answer is B
https://repost.aws/
https://repost.aws/

question.en:
A company needs to search for text in documents that are stored in Amazon S3.

Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
question.ja:
ある企業は、Amazon S3に保存されているドキュメント内のテキストを検索する必要があります。

この要件を満たすAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kendra/latest/dg/what-is-kendra.html
https://aws.amazon.com/kendra/?p=pm&c=ml&pd=kd&z=4

A. Amazon Kendra Amazon Kendra is an AWS service designed for building intelligent search capabilities into applications. It supports natural language queries and allows you to search for text in documents stored in various sources, including Amazon S3. Kendra is optimized for enterprise-scale data and can index and search across different types of content, making it suitable for searching text in documents.

answer is A. - Amazon Rekognition is a cloud-based image and video analysis service that makes it easy to add advanced computer vision capabilities to your applications. - Amazon Polly is a machine learning service that converts text to speech. -Amazon Lex is a service that builds conversational interfaces using voice and text.

A. Amazon Kendra Amazon Kendra is a highly accurate and easy-to-use intelligent search service powered by machine learning. It enables you to index your documents, including text in various formats, and provides natural language search capabilities.

question.en: Which AWS services make use of global edge locations? (Choose two.)
question.ja: グローバルなエッジロケーションを利用するAWSサービスはどれですか？(2つ選択してください。)

C. B & C is the correct option Networking services Amazon CloudFront, AWS Global Accelerator, and Amazon Route 53 sit at AWS' global edge locations connected by dedicated 100Gbps redundant fiber to deliver data with single digit millisecond AWS network latency.
answers are B and C
the answer is BC

question.en:
A user needs a relational database but does not have the resources to manage the hardware, resiliency, and replication.

Which AWS service option meets the user's requirements?
question.ja:
あるユーザーはリレーショナルデータベースを必要としていますが、ハードウェア、回復性、レプリケーションを管理するリソースを持っていません。

このユーザーの要件を満たすAWSサービスオプションはどれですか?

text.en: Run MySQL on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS).

question.en:
A company wants to use application stacks to run a workload in the AWS Cloud. The company wants to use pre-configured instances.

Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
question.ja:
ある企業は、AWSクラウドでワークロードを実行するためにアプリケーションスタックを使用したいと考えています。この企業は、事前構成済みのインスタンスを使用したいと考えています。

この要件を満たすAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: LightSail gets you started quickly with preconfigured Linux and Windows application stacks and an intuitive management console. https://aws.amazon.com/free/compute/lightsail/?trk=13b576c7-da6f-4140-99fb-c995644b5b46&sc_channel=ps&ef_id=Cj0KCQiAnfmsBhDfARIsAM7MKi3tzalv_9YtKe_wGWw-C2gG-kay_JhyzyBG_bnDcLKeoyKyg7klfI8aAouNEALw_wcB:G:s&s_kwcid=AL!4422!3!536393441656!p!!g!!lightsail%20cloud!11543056261!112002970709&gclid=Cj0KCQiAnfmsBhDfARIsAM7MKi3tzalv_9YtKe_wGWw-C2gG-kay_JhyzyBG_bnDcLKeoyKyg7klfI8aAouNEALw_wcB

A. Amazon Lightsail Amazon Lightsail is the AWS service that provides pre-configured instances and application stacks designed to simplify the process of deploying and managing applications in the cloud. It is a straightforward way for users to launch instances with pre-configured templates for common use cases, making it easy to get started without the need for extensive AWS expertise. Therefore, for the specific requirements of using pre-configured instances and application stacks, Amazon Lightsail (Option A) is the most suitable choice.

Lightsail is the most suitable choice: -Pre-configured Instances and Application Stacks: Lightsail offers a wide range of pre-configured instances with popular software stacks already installed and ready to use

Amazon Lightsail can deploy application stacks. For instance, you can deploy a LAMP (Linux Apache MySQL PHP) stack application onto a single Lightsail instance 1. Amazon Lightsail offers virtual servers, storage, databases, and networking, plus a cost-effective, monthly plan 12. You can also use Amazon Lightsail to develop, deploy, and manage LAMP stack applications on AWS 2. If you are interested in automating the deployment of your applications to Amazon Lightsail, you can use AWS CodeDeploy and AWS CodePipeline.

explanation.ja: 正解はA。Amazon Lightsailは事前構成済みのアプリケーションスタック（WordPress、LAMPなど）を含むインスタンスを簡単にデプロイできる簡易仮想サーバーサービス。Amazon Athenaはクエリサービス、AWS Outpostsはオンプレミス拡張、Amazon EC2は自分でOSやミドルウェアを構成する必要があり、事前構成済みという要件にはLightsailが適する。

この要件を満たすS3の機能はどれですか?

text.ja: S3インベントリレポート

comment.en: To keep track of objects and their respective tags, buckets, and prefixes, you can use an S3 Inventory report https://aws.amazon.com/s3/features/
the answer is A
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-inventory.html

A. S3 Inventory report S3 Inventory provides details about your objects, including metadata and tags, on a scheduled basis. You can configure it to generate reports that list your objects and their corresponding tags, allowing you to track and manage your S3 objects more effectively.

explanation.ja: 正解はA。S3インベントリレポートは、バケット内のオブジェクトのタグ、バケット、プレフィックスなどのメタデータを定期的にレポートとして出力する機能。S3ライフサイクルはストレージクラス移行、S3バージョニングは世代管理、S3 ACLはアクセス制御であり、オブジェクトの一覧・メタデータ追跡にはインベントリレポートが適する。

question.en:
A company wants to allow users to authenticate and authorize multiple AWS accounts by using a single set of credentials.

Which AWS service or resource will meet this requirement?
question.ja:
ある企業は、単一の認証情報セットを使用して複数のAWSアカウントの認証と認可をユーザーに許可したいと考えています。

この要件を満たすAWSサービスまたはリソースはどれですか?

text.en: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
text.ja: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)

comment.en: C. AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) AWS Single Sign-On (SSO) enables centralized authentication and authorization across multiple AWS accounts and other business applications. It allows users to sign in once and access resources in various accounts without the need for separate credentials for each account. This helps simplify access management in a multi-account environment.
AWS SSO

explanation.ja: 正解はC。AWS IAM Identity Center（旧AWS SSO）は、単一の認証情報セットで複数のAWSアカウントへのシングルサインオンと認可を実現する。AWS Organizationsはアカウントのグループ化・管理、IAMユーザーはアカウントごとに個別作成が必要、AWS Control Towerはマルチアカウント環境の構築サービスであり、単一認証情報での複数アカウントアクセスにはIAM Identity Centerが適する。

question.en:
A company created an Amazon EC2 instance. The company wants to control the incoming and outgoing network traffic at the instance level.

Which AWS resource or service will meet this requirement?
question.ja:
ある企業がAmazon EC2インスタンスを作成しました。この企業は、インスタンスレベルで受信・送信ネットワークトラフィックを制御したいと考えています。

この要件を満たすAWSリソースまたはサービスはどれですか?

text.ja: セキュリティグループ

comment.en: B. Security groups Security groups act as virtual firewalls for your Amazon EC2 instances, controlling inbound and outbound traffic. You can configure security groups to allow or deny traffic based on rules that you define. By associating a security group with an EC2 instance, you can control the traffic to and from that instance at the network level.
Security group for VM.
Answer : B. Security Groups
Keyword is instance.
security groups
B is the correct answer

explanation.ja: 正解はB。セキュリティグループはインスタンスレベルで受信・送信のネットワークトラフィックを制御するステートフルなファイアウォール。AWS ShieldはDDoS対策、Network Access Analyzerはネットワーク経路の到達可能性分析、VPCエンドポイントは特定サービスへの接続機能であり、インスタンスレベルのトラフィック制御そのものはセキュリティグループが担う。

question.en:
A company wants to use the AWS Cloud to deploy an application globally.

Which architecture deployment model should the company use to meet this requirement?
question.ja:
ある企業は、AWSクラウドを使用してアプリケーションをグローバルに展開したいと考えています。

この要件を満たすために企業が使用すべきアーキテクチャのデプロイモデルはどれですか?

comment.en: A. Multi-Region Using a Multi-Region architecture allows you to distribute your application across different AWS regions, providing redundancy and minimizing the impact of potential regional failures. This helps in achieving global reach and ensures better availability and performance for users in different parts of the world.
Multi-region
Globally=multi-region

Answer is A While a multi-AZ deployment can provide better availability and resilience than a single-region deployment, it is not the most appropriate architecture for deploying an application globally because it does not offer the same level of performance and latency reduction as a multi-region deployment. In a multi-AZ deployment, the application is deployed in multiple Availability Zones (AZs) within the same region. This means that the application is still subject to regional outages, which can affect users in that region. Additionally, latency to users in other regions may still be high.
Multi region
A, Multi-Region. Darn, these are bad from about question 250 up....
Multi-region
Ans is A

explanation.ja: 正解はA。アプリケーションをグローバルに展開するには、複数のAWSリージョンにワークロードを配置するマルチリージョンアーキテクチャが必要。シングルリージョンは特定地域内に限定され、マルチAZ/シングルAZは単一リージョン内の可用性設計であり、グローバル展開そのものを実現するものではない。

question.en:
A company wants a web application to interact with various AWS services.

Which AWS service or resource will meet this requirement?
question.ja:
ある企業は、Webアプリケーションがさまざまなサービスと連携できるようにしたいと考えています。

text.ja: AWSマネジメントコンソール

While the AWS Management Console is intended for human users, it does not directly interact with web applications or other AWS services in an automated or programmatic way. The web application to interact with AWS services programmatically, one would typically use other tools, such as: AWS SDKs , AWS CLI, AWS APIs
the question is badly defined

To ambiguous, as it can be read different ways which will be answered differently; A company wants a web application to (be created that will) interact with various AWS services. It provides a user-friendly way to access and manage AWS resources without the need for any additional software installation. https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsconsolehelpdocs/latest/gsg/learn-whats-new.html

Management Console. The AWS Management Console provides a web-based user interface to access and manage AWS services, making it ideal for interacting with various AWS resources through a web application.

explanation.ja: 正解はC。AWSマネジメントコンソールはWebベースのGUIで各種AWSサービスとの連携（設定・呼び出し）を行える一般的な手段。AWS CloudShellはブラウザ内シェル、AWS Marketplaceはソフトウェア調達、AWS CLIはコマンドライン操作であり、Webアプリケーションと各種サービスとの連携という表現には、GUIでの設定・確認を含むマネジメントコンソールが最も広く該当する。

question.en:
A company is migrating its applications from on-premises to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to ensure that the applications are assigned only the minimum permissions that are needed to perform all operations.

Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
question.ja:
ある企業が、自社のアプリケーションをオンプレミスからAWSクラウドに移行しています。この企業は、アプリケーションにすべての操作を実行するために必要な最小限の権限のみが割り当てられるようにしたいと考えています。

この要件を満たすAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: IAM is the service in AWS that enables you to manage access to AWS services and resources securely. With IAM, you can create and manage AWS users and groups, and you can grant them permissions to access specific AWS resources. IAM allows you to define fine-grained permissions, ensuring that each application or user is assigned only the minimum permissions needed to perform their required operations. This aligns with the principle of least privilege.

A. AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) AWS IAM is the service specifically designed for managing access to AWS services and resources. It allows you to create and manage users, groups, and roles and define fine-grained permissions through policies. By carefully crafting IAM policies, you can grant only the necessary permissions to each application or user, following the principle of least privilege.
A is the correct answer
Answer is A
Agree with AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)
Answer : A
A is the correct answer

explanation.ja: 正解はA。AWS IAMを使用して最小権限の原則に基づくポリシーを設計・適用することで、アプリケーションに必要最小限の権限のみを付与できる。Amazon CloudWatchは監視、Amazon Macieは機密データ検出、Amazon GuardDutyは脅威検出であり、権限管理そのものを担うのはIAMである。

question.en: Which options are AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) governance perspective capabilities? (Choose two.)
question.ja: AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) のガバナンス視点の能力に該当するのはどれですか？(2つ選択してください。)

text.ja: アプリケーションポートフォリオ管理

comment.en: B & C is correct answer
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/governance-perspective.html

A & B - Correct Answer Governance in AWS CAF involves establishing policies, controls, and mechanisms to ensure that the organization's use of the cloud aligns with business objectives, complies with regulations, and follows best practices. Key elements of AWS CAF governance include: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Cloud Financial Management Security Compliance Operations Resource Lifecycle Management Risk Management Change Management Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/governance-perspective.html
B & C are correct answers
B&C: Identity & Access Management is in Security; Product Management is in Business
Governance Perspectives are; - IT Governance - Cloud strategy and roadmap - Portfolio management - Cost management and optimization
A. Identity and access management B. Cloud financial management
A. AWS Application Discovery Service B. AWS Application Migration Service
B. Cloud financial management C. Application portfolio management

A. Identity and access management and B. Cloud financial management. These are two of the six capabilities that belong to the AWS CAF governance perspective, which helps you orchestrate your cloud initiatives while maximizing organizational benefits and minimizing transformation-related risks.
A and B

explanation.ja: 正解はB、C。AWS CAFの「ガバナンス」視点には、クラウド財務管理やアプリケーションポートフォリオ管理といった統制・管理系の能力が含まれる。IDおよびアクセス管理はセキュリティ視点、イノベーション管理とプロダクト管理はビジネス視点に分類され、ガバナンス視点の能力ではない。

question.en: Which AWS service provides a single location to track the progress of application migrations?
question.ja: アプリケーション移行の進捗状況を追跡するための単一の場所を提供するAWSサービスはどれですか?

question.en: Which architecture concept describes the ability to deploy resources on demand and release resources when they are no longer needed?

弾力性(エラスティシティ)

comment.en: https://wa.aws.amazon.com/wat.concept.elasticity.en.html
Elasticity: The ability to automatically or dynamically increase or decrease resources as needed.
Correct answer: D
It is Elasticity. D is the correct answer.
D : Elasticity
Elasticity is “The ability to acquire resources as you need them and release resources when you no longer need them
D is correct

explanation.ja: 正解はD。弾力性（エラスティシティ）は、需要に応じてリソースをデプロイし、不要になれば解放できる能力を表す。高可用性は障害時のサービス継続性、疎結合アーキテクチャはコンポーネント間の依存低減、レジリエンスは障害からの回復力を指し、リソースの増減能力を直接表すのは弾力性である。

question.en: Which task requires a user to sign in as the AWS account root user?
question.ja: ユーザーがAWSアカウントのルートユーザーとしてサインインする必要があるタスクはどれですか?

The creation of an organization in AWS Organizations

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/accounts/latest/reference/manage-acct-closing.html

The AWS account root user has the highest level of access and is associated with the email address used to create the AWS account. Certain tasks, such as the deletion of an entire AWS account, can only be performed by the AWS account root user. Other administrative tasks, like creating an organization in AWS Organizations or deleting IAM users, can often be performed by IAM users with appropriate permissions, and it is recommended to use IAM users instead of relying on the root user for day-to-day activities.
Correct answer: C
B is correct

question.en: What does the Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class offer?
question.ja: Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tieringストレージクラスが提供するものはどれですか?

text.en: Payment flexibility by reserving storage capacity
text.ja: ストレージ容量を予約することによる支払いの柔軟性

text.en: Long-term retention of data by copying the data to an encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume
text.ja: 暗号化されたAmazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) ボリュームにデータをコピーすることによる長期的なデータ保持

text.en: Automatic cost savings by moving objects between tiers based on access pattern changes
text.ja: アクセスパターンの変化に基づいてオブジェクトを階層間で自動的に移動することによるコスト削減

text.en: Secure, durable, and lowest cost storage for data archival
text.ja: データアーカイブ向けの、安全で耐久性があり最も低コストなストレージ

comment.en: https://aws.amazon.com/s3/storage-classes/intelligent-tiering/
C is the correct answer
the answer is C

Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering is the only cloud storage class that delivers automatic storage cost savings when data access patterns change, without performance impact or operational overhead. https://aws.amazon.com/s3/storage-classes/intelligent-tiering/
Answer : C
C is the correct answer

Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering is a storage class that automatically optimizes costs by moving objects between two access tiers—frequent and infrequent access—based on changing access patterns. It is designed to deliver the same low latency and high throughput performance of the S3 Standard storage class. This storage class automatically adjusts as access patterns change over time, optimizing costs without performance impact.

explanation.ja: 正解はC。S3 Intelligent-Tieringはオブジェクトへのアクセスパターンの変化を自動的に監視し、最適なストレージ階層へ自動移動することでコストを削減する。ストレージ容量の予約による柔軟性、EBSへのコピーによる長期保持、アーカイブ向けの低コストストレージはそれぞれ他のS3機能やストレージクラスの説明であり、Intelligent-Tieringの特徴とは異なる。

question.en:

ある企業は、中断を許容できるワークロードのためにAmazon EC2インスタンスを必要としています。

question.en:
A company is planning to migrate to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to identify measurable business outcomes that will explain the value of the company's decision to migrate.

Which phase of the cloud transformation journey includes these activities?
question.ja:
ある企業がAWSクラウドへの移行を計画しています。この企業は、移行という決定の価値を説明できる、測定可能なビジネス上の成果を特定したいと考えています。

クラウド変革の旅のどのフェーズにこれらの活動が含まれますか?

comment.en: AWS Cloud Adoption Framework - CAF: Phases There're 4 phases: How it works 1. Envision : identify measurable business outcomes and prioritize transformation opportunities in line with your strategic objectives. 2. Align : Identify capability gaps and cross-organizational dependencies. 3. Launch : focus executing cloud migration, deliver pilots in production 4. Scale : optimizing and expanding cloud capabilities / expand pilots and business value
https://aws.amazon.com/cloud-adoption-framework/#:~:text=and%20customer%20experience.-,How%20it%20works,-Envision
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/your-cloud-transformation-journey.html

Envison is the correct answer. Envision Identify and prioritize transformation opportunities in line with your strategic objectives. Associating your transformation initiatives with key stakeholders and measurable business outcomes will help you demonstrate value as you progress through your transformation journey.
A. Envision
a. Envision

The Align phase focuses on defining the business case, creating a cloud adoption plan, and aligning stakeholders around the value proposition of the cloud migration. During this phase, organizations typically identify key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurable business outcomes that demonstrate the success and benefits of the migration.

explanation.ja: 正解はA。「Envision（構想）」フェーズでは、経営層がクラウド移行によって得られる測定可能なビジネス上の成果を特定し、その価値を明確化する。Align（整合）はギャップ特定、Launch（始動）は実行、Scale（拡大）は展開拡大のフェーズであり、成果の特定という活動はEnvisionに該当する。

comment.en: For AWS cloud development, the built-in choice for infrastructure as code is AWS CloudFormation. https://www.freecodecamp.org/news/how-to-implement-infrastructure-as-code-with-aws/#:~:text=Infrastructure%20as%20code%20is%20the,as%20code%20is%20AWS%20CloudFormation.

explanation.ja: 正解はB。S3 Transfer Accelerationは、AWSのエッジロケーションとバックボーンネットワークを経由する最適化された経路でアップロード・ダウンロードを高速化し、レイテンシーを削減する。S3クロスリージョンレプリケーションは複製機能、S3イベント通知はイベント連携、Standard-IAはコスト最適化のストレージクラスであり、転送速度の向上を主目的とはしない。

question.en: Which AWS service provides the ability to host a NoSQL database in the AWS Cloud?
question.ja: AWSクラウドでNoSQLデータベースをホストする機能を提供するAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html

explanation.ja: 正解はB。Amazon DynamoDBはフルマネージドのNoSQLデータベースサービス。Amazon Aurora、Amazon RDSはリレーショナルデータベース、Amazon Redshiftはデータウェアハウスであり、NoSQLデータベースのホスティングという要件にはDynamoDBが該当する。

question.en: Which AWS service is a relational database compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL?
question.ja: MySQLおよびPostgreSQLと互換性のあるリレーショナルデータベースであるAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: Amazon Aurora is a fully managed relational database service that is compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL. It provides high performance and availability with the ease of use of a fully managed database service.
REDSHIFT IS A DATAWAREHOUSE
Amazon Aurora is a global-scale relational database service built for the cloud with full MySQL and PostgreSQL compatibility. https://aws.amazon.com/rds/aurora/
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html

c: Amazon Aurora
Amazon Aurora is a relational database management system (RDBMS) built for the cloud with full MySQL and PostgreSQL compatibility.

question.en: Which architecture design principle describes the need to isolate failures between dependent components in the AWS Cloud?
question.ja: AWSクラウドにおいて、依存するコンポーネント間で障害を分離する必要性を表すアーキテクチャの設計原則はどれですか?

text.ja: モノリシックな設計を使用する。
自動化を前提に設計する。

text.en: Design for single points of failure.
text.ja: 単一障害点を前提に設計する。
コンポーネントを疎結合にする。

comment.en: Loosely couple components (microservices) are conceptually small pieces of "monolithic" application created/implemented to isolate failures between dependent components in the AWS Cloud

Loosely coupling components is a design principle that emphasizes minimizing dependencies between different components in a system. This helps isolate failures, meaning that if one component fails or undergoes changes, it doesn't have a significant impact on other components. This design principle contributes to increased resilience, flexibility, and easier maintenance of the overall system.
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/oe-design-principles.html
D. Loosely couple components.
is the correct answer

explanation.ja: 正解はD。コンポーネントを疎結合にすることで、あるコンポーネントの障害が他のコンポーネントに波及するのを防ぎ、依存関係間で障害を分離できる。モノリシックな設計は逆に密結合を招き、単一障害点を前提とする設計は障害耐性に反し、自動化を前提とすることは別の設計原則（運用上の優秀性）であり、障害分離を直接表すものではない。

question.en: Which benefit of cloud computing gives a company the ability to deploy applications to users all over the world through a network of AWS Regions, Availability Zones, and edge locations?
question.ja: AWSリージョン、アベイラビリティーゾーン、エッジロケーションのネットワークを通じて、世界中のユーザーにアプリケーションをデプロイできる能力を企業に与えるクラウドコンピューティングの利点はどれですか?

comment.en: The benefit of cloud computing that provides the ability to deploy applications to users all over the world through a network of AWS Regions, Availability Zones, and edge locations is referred to as "Global reach." AWS has a global infrastructure with multiple Regions, each consisting of multiple Availability Zones, and edge locations for content delivery. This global reach allows companies to distribute their applications and content closer to end-users, reducing latency and improving the overall user experience.
don't worry the answer must be B
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html Go Global in minutes = Global Reach
https://cloudza.io/aws/
B. Global reach
Global reach is the correct answer

explanation.ja: 正解はB。グローバルなリーチは、リージョン・アベイラビリティーゾーン・エッジロケーションのグローバルなネットワークを通じて、世界中のユーザーにアプリケーションを展開できる利点を指す。規模の経済、俊敏性、高可用性はそれぞれ別の利点であり、地理的な展開能力を直接表すのはグローバルなリーチである。

question.en: Which AWS service makes it easier to monitor and troubleshoot application logs and cloud resources?
question.ja: アプリケーションログとクラウドリソースの監視・トラブルシューティングを容易にするAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: Amazon CloudWatch is the AWS service that makes it easier to monitor and troubleshoot application logs and cloud resources. CloudWatch allows you to collect and track metrics, collect and monitor log files, set alarms, and automatically react to changes in your AWS resources. It provides a unified view of your AWS resources, applications, and services that run on AWS. With CloudWatch, you can gain system-wide visibility into resource utilization, application performance, and operational health.
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/logging-monitoring-for-application-owners/aws-services-logging-monitoring.html
https://aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/features/#:~:text=CloudWatch%20enables%20you%20to%20monitor,building%20applications%20and%20business%20value.
Answer : C. Amazon CloudWatch

Amazon CloudWatch is an AWS monitoring service for cloud resources and the applications that you run on AWS. You can use Amazon CloudWatch to collect and track metrics, collect and monitor log files, and set alarms.

explanation.ja: 正解はC。Amazon CloudWatchはアプリケーションログの収集とクラウドリソースのメトリクス監視を統合的に提供し、トラブルシューティングを容易にする。Amazon EC2はコンピューティングリソースそのもの、AWS IAMはアクセス管理、AWS CloudTrailはAPI操作ログであり、ログとメトリクスの統合監視という点ではCloudWatchが該当する。

question.en: Which AWS service uses AWS Compute Optimizer to provide sizing recommendations based on workload metrics?
question.ja: ワークロードのメトリクスに基づいてサイジングの推奨事項を提供するためにAWS Compute Optimizerを使用するAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: AWS Compute Optimizer analyzes metrics from the past 14 days to generate recommendations for Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) and EC2 Auto-Scaling Groups, but you can change the settings to 32 or 93 days. Compute Optimizer analyzes metrics from the past 14 days to generate recommendations for other resource types. https://aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/faqs/#:~:text=AWS%20Compute%20Optimizer%20analyzes%20metrics,recommendations%20for%20other%20resource%20types.
Answer: A https://aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/what-is-compute-optimizer.html#:~:text=Compute%20Optimizer%20generates%20recommendations%20for%20the%20following%20resources%3A

A. Amazon EC2 AWS Compute Optimizer provides sizing recommendations for Amazon EC2 instances based on workload metrics. It analyzes historical resource utilization data to identify opportunities for optimization and provides recommendations for optimal instance types and sizes to improve performance and cost efficiency.
Amazon EC2 is the correct answer

AWS Compute Optimizer provides sizing recommendations for Amazon EC2 instances based on workload metrics. It analyzes historical usage data and recommends optimal instance types, sizes, and families for your workloads to improve performance and reduce costs.

explanation.ja: 正解はA。AWS Compute Optimizerは主にAmazon EC2インスタンスのメトリクスを分析し、最適なインスタンスタイプ・サイズを推奨する（EBSボリュームやLambda関数にも対応するが、代表的な対象はEC2）。Amazon RDS、Amazon Lightsail、AWS Step Functionsはそれぞれ別のサービスであり、Compute Optimizerの主要な推奨対象ではない。

question.en: Which AWS service will help a company plan a migration to AWS by collecting the configuration, usage, and behavior data of on-premises data centers?
question.ja: オンプレミスのデータセンターの構成、使用状況、動作データを収集することで、企業がAWSへの移行を計画するのに役立つAWSサービスはどれですか?

AWS Application Discovery Service helps you plan your migration to the AWS cloud by collecting usage and configuration data about your on-premises servers and databases.
AWS Application Discovery Service https://docs.aws.amazon.com/application-discovery/latest/userguide/what-is-appdiscovery.html
B. AWS Application Discovery Service

explanation.ja: 正解はB。AWS Application Discovery Serviceはオンプレミスサーバーの構成・使用状況・パフォーマンスデータを収集し、移行計画の立案を支援する。AWS Resource Groupsはリソースの整理、AWS Service Catalogはカタログ管理、AWS Systems Managerは運用管理であり、オンプレミス環境の情報収集を主目的とするのはApplication Discovery Serviceである。

question.en: Which AWS service uses a combination of publishers and subscribers?

question.en: Which AWS service or tool will monitor AWS resources and applications in real time?
question.ja: AWSリソースとアプリケーションをリアルタイムで監視するAWSサービスまたはツールはどれですか?

question.en: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) capability belongs to the business perspective?

question.en: Which AWS resource can help a company reduce its costs in exchange for a usage commitment when using Amazon EC2 instances?

question.en: Which perspective in the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) includes a capability for well-designed data and analytics architecture?
question.ja: AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) の視点のうち、適切に設計されたデータおよび分析アーキテクチャの能力が含まれるのはどれですか?

comment.en: The keyword "architecture", answer is D

question.en: Which options are AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) people perspective capabilities? (Choose two.)

AC correct answers

question.en:
A company needs a bridge between technology and business to help evolve to a culture of continuous growth and learning.

Which perspective in the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) serves as this bridge?
question.ja:
ある企業は、継続的な成長と学習の文化へ進化するのを支援するために、テクノロジーとビジネスの橋渡しを必要としています。

AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) のどの視点がこの橋渡しの役割を果たしますか?

People Perspective serves as a bridge between technology and business, accelerating the cloud journey to help organizations more rapidly evolve to a culture of continuous growth, learning, and where change becomes business-as-normal, with focus on culture, organizational structure, leadership, and workforce.
People perspective - Culture Evolution

question.en: Which AWS Well-Architected Framework pillar focuses on structured and streamlined allocation of computing resources?
question.ja: コンピューティングリソースの構造化され合理化された割り当てに重点を置くAWS Well-Architected Frameworkの柱はどれですか?

explanation.ja: 正解はC。パフォーマンス効率の柱は、コンピューティングリソースを構造化・合理化して効率的に割り当て、需要変化に応じて効率性を維持することに重点を置く。信頼性は障害復旧、運用上の優秀性はプロセス改善、持続可能性は環境負荷低減を扱う柱であり、リソース割り当ての効率化を直接表すのはパフォーマンス効率である。

question.en: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) capabilities belong to the governance perspective? (Choose two.)
question.ja: AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) の能力のうち、ガバナンス視点に属するものはどれですか？(2つ選択してください。)

text.ja: プログラムおよびプロジェクト管理

comment.en: A and D are correct. https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/foundational-capabilities.html
B - Business Perspective C - Application Portfolio Management E - Operations Perspective

In the AWS CAF Governance perspective, the standard capabilities are: Strategy management Portfolio management Investment and budgeting Risk management Policy and compliance “Program and project management” is part of the AWS CAF Operations perspective (it sits alongside capabilities like service management, change management, and incident/event management). “Event management” is also an Operations capability. “Product management” aligns more with the Business perspective. A and D are correct https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/foundational-capabilities.html

explanation.ja: 正解はA、D。AWS CAFの「ガバナンス」視点には、プログラム・プロジェクト管理やリスク管理といった統制系の能力が含まれる。プロダクト管理とポートフォリオ管理はビジネス視点、イベント管理はオペレーション視点に分類され、ガバナンス視点の能力ではない。

question.en:
A company wants to use AWS Managed Services (AMS) for operational support and wants to understand the scope of AMS.

Which AMS feature will meet these requirements?
question.ja:
ある企業は、運用サポートにAWS Managed Services (AMS) を使用したいと考えており、AMSの対応範囲を理解したいと考えています。

この要件を満たすAMSの機能はどれですか?

text.ja: ランディングゾーンとネットワーク管理
顧客のアプリケーション開発
アプリケーションログの監視

comment.en: A. Landing zone and network management AWS Managed Services (AMS) offers landing zone and network management as part of its scope to assist companies in setting up and managing their AWS environment. This includes establishing a secure and well-architected foundation for workloads, setting up network connectivity, managing accounts and users, implementing security controls, and ensuring compliance with best practices and regulatory requirements.
WRONG!

AWS Managed Services (AMS) provides operational support for AWS infrastructure and services. This includes managing and monitoring application logs to ensure they are available, secure, and compliant with the company's requirements. Landing zone and network management, customer application development, and DevSecOps pipeline configuration are not typically part of the AMS scope.
D. Application log monitoring
Answer is correct

explanation.ja: 正解はA。AWS Managed Services (AMS) は、ランディングゾーンの構築やネットワーク管理を含むインフラ運用をAWSが代行する。顧客のアプリケーション開発そのものやDevSecOpsパイプラインの構成、アプリケーションログの詳細な監視は顧客側または別サービスの領域であり、AMSの中核的な対応範囲とは異なる。

question.en:
A company wants to migrate its on-premises NoSQL workload to Amazon DynamoDB.

Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
question.ja:
ある企業は、自社のオンプレミスのNoSQLワークロードをAmazon DynamoDBに移行したいと考えています。

この要件を満たすAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: B. AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) AWS DMS helps to migrate databases to AWS quickly and securely. It supports various source and target databases, including NoSQL databases like MongoDB, Cassandra, and Couchbase, making it suitable for migrating an on-premises NoSQL workload to Amazon DynamoDB.
Given answer is correct

explanation.ja: 正解はB。AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) は、オンプレミスのNoSQLワークロードを含む各種データベースをAmazon DynamoDBなどに移行できるサービス。AWS Migration Hubは進捗の追跡、Migration Evaluatorはコスト評価、AWS Application Migration Serviceはサーバーのリホスト向けであり、データベース移行の実行そのものにはDMSが適する。

question.en:
A company is in the process of finding correct Amazon EC2 instance types and sizes to meet its performance and capacity requirements. The company wants to find the lowest possible cost.

Which option accurately characterizes the company's actions?
question.ja:
ある企業が、パフォーマンスと容量の要件を満たす適切なAmazon EC2インスタンスタイプとサイズを見つける作業を進めています。この企業は、可能な限り低いコストを見つけたいと考えています。

この企業の行動を正確に表す選択肢はどれですか?

text.ja: 適切なサイジング(ライトサイジング)
インスタンスのスケジューリング

comment.en: C. Rightsizing Rightsizing involves finding the most suitable instance types and sizes to match performance and capacity requirements while optimizing costs. This process ensures that resources are neither underutilized nor over-provisioned, helping to minimize expenses while meeting workload demands.
Answer is correct

explanation.ja: 正解はC。パフォーマンスと容量の要件を満たしつつ最も低コストなインスタンスタイプ・サイズを見つける取り組みは、適切なサイジング（ライトサイジング）そのものを指す。Auto Scaling、ストレージ階層化、インスタンスのスケジューリングはそれぞれ別のコスト最適化手法であり、インスタンスタイプ・サイズの選定作業そのものではない。

question.en:
A company wants to manage sign-in security for workforce users. The company needs to create workforce users and centrally manage their access across all the company's AWS accounts and applications.

Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
question.ja:
ある企業は、従業員ユーザーのサインインセキュリティを管理したいと考えています。この企業は、従業員ユーザーを作成し、自社のすべてのAWSアカウントとアプリケーションにわたってそのアクセスを一元的に管理する必要があります。

この要件を満たすAWSサービスはどれですか?

text.en: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
text.ja: AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)

comment.en: I believe it's correct because "The AWS access portal provides IAM Identity Center users with single sign-on access to all their assigned AWS accounts and applications through a web portal." So it's centrally managed. And: ". Use IAM Identity Center with your existing identity source or create a new directory, and manage workforce access to part or all of your AWS environment."
Cognito = User authentication for Apps IAM Identity Center = Centralized access management for AWS and Apps The answer is D) AWS IAM Identity Center

D. AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) AWS IAM Identity Center, also known as AWS Single Sign-On (SSO), is a service that simplifies the management of access to AWS accounts and business applications by providing centralized identity and access management. With AWS SSO, companies can create and manage workforce users, control their access to AWS accounts and applications using single sign-on, and enforce multi-factor authentication for enhanced security. This service helps streamline access management and ensures consistent security practices across the organization's AWS environment.
D. AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)
would someone help with 392? much appreciation.
I think it's D, as Cognito is more for third-part applications like credentials for facebook, etc.
Can someone please check if B is actually the right answer?

Per Copilot: The AWS service that will meet these requirements is Amazon Cognito. It provides a comprehensive solution for managing sign-in security, user authentication, and access control across multiple AWS accounts and applications.

explanation.ja: 正解はD。AWS IAM Identity Center（旧AWS SSO）は、従業員ユーザーを一元管理し、複数のAWSアカウントやアプリケーションへのアクセスを一元的に制御できる。AWS Audit Managerは監査証跡の収集、Amazon Cognitoは主に自社アプリのエンドユーザー向け認証、AWS Security Hubは検出結果の集約であり、従業員の一元的なアクセス管理にはIAM Identity Centerが適する。

question.en:
A company wants a report that lists the status of multi-factor authentication (MFA) devices that all users in the company's AWS account use.

Which AWS feature or service will meet this requirement?
question.ja:
ある企業は、自社のAWSアカウント内のすべてのユーザーが使用する多要素認証(MFA)デバイスのステータスを一覧表示するレポートを求めています。

この要件を満たすAWSの機能またはサービスはどれですか?

text.en: Detailed Billing Reports -D AWS Cost Explorer reports
text.ja: 詳細請求レポート -D AWS Cost Explorerレポート

comment.en: The correct AWS feature or service that meets the requirement of generating a report listing the status of MFA devices for all users in an AWS account is B. IAM credential reports.

explanation.ja: 正解はB。IAM認証情報レポートは、アカウント内の全IAMユーザーについてパスワード・アクセスキーに加えMFAデバイスの有効化状況も一覧化できる。Cost and Usage ReportsやCost Explorerレポート、詳細請求レポートはいずれも請求・使用量に関するレポートであり、MFAの状態確認には向かない。

question.en:
A company wants to use machine learning capabilities to analyze log data from its Amazon EC2 instances and efficiently conduct security investigations.

Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
question.ja:
ある企業は、Amazon EC2インスタンスからのログデータを分析し、効率的にセキュリティ調査を行うために機械学習の機能を使用したいと考えています。

この要件を満たすAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: C. Amazon Detective Amazon Detective makes it easy to analyze, investigate, and quickly identify the root cause of security issues or suspicious activities. It automatically collects log data from your AWS resources and uses machine learning, statistical analysis, and graph theory to build a linked set of data that enables you to easily conduct investigations. While Amazon GuardDuty is effective for detecting threats, Amazon Detective specializes in analyzing and investigating the security findings that GuardDuty and other services detect, making it an excellent choice for efficiently conducting security investigations with machine learning capabilities.
Scratch that. It's definitely D. https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html GuardDuty specifically uses ML

C. Amazon Detective Amazon Detective is a fully managed service that helps you to investigate potential security issues or suspicious activities across your AWS environment, including EC2 instances. It automatically collects log data from multiple AWS sources, such as VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, and GuardDuty findings, and uses machine learning, statistical analysis, and graph theory to build interactive visualizations and make it easier to identify security issues and conduct investigations.
Amazon Detective is the best service for conducting security investigations using machine learning to analyze log data from Amazon EC2 instances and other AWS resources.

Amazon Detective: 1.Investigate and quickly identify the root cause of potential security issues. 2.Automatically collect log data from your AWS resources and uses machine learning to help you visualize and conduct security investigations.

Amazon Detective: 1.Investigate and quickly identify the root cause of potential security issues. 2.Automatically collect log data from your AWS resources and uses machine learning to help you visualize and conduct security investigations.
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/what-is-detective.html I think the key is this: "Detective automatically collects log data from your AWS resources"
correct D: Amazon GuardDuty • Intelligent Threat discovery to protect your AWS Account • Uses Machine Learning algorithms, anomaly detection, 3rd party data

C: Amazon Detective A managed security service that helps security analysts investigate security issues. Detective can analyze security findings from multiple sources, including GuardDuty, to help identify the root cause of malicious activity. Detective provides interactive visualizations and insights to help users investigate issues more quickly. Amazon GuardDuty A threat detection service that continuously monitors AWS environments for unauthorized access and malicious activity. GuardDuty provides real-time alerts and detailed findings to help security teams respond to security incidents.
D Amazon GuardDuty
It's C : https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/what-is-detective.html
Analyze " Log data" is the key here.

explanation.ja: 正解はC。Amazon Detectiveは、GuardDutyなどが検出したログデータを機械学習で分析し、セキュリティインシデントの根本原因を効率的に調査できるサービス。Amazon Inspectorは脆弱性診断、Amazon QuickSightはBIダッシュボード、Amazon GuardDutyは脅威の検出（調査より検知が主目的）であり、機械学習を用いたログ分析による調査支援という点ではDetectiveが該当する。

question.en:
A company is launching a mobile app in the AWS Cloud. The company wants the app's users to sign in through social media identity providers (IdPs).

Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
question.ja:
ある企業が、AWSクラウドでモバイルアプリを立ち上げようとしています。この企業は、アプリのユーザーがソーシャルメディアのIDプロバイダー(IdP)を通じてサインインできるようにしたいと考えています。

この要件を満たすAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: B. Amazon Cognito Amazon Cognito provides authentication, authorization, and user management for web and mobile apps. Users can sign in directly with a user name and password, or through third-party identity providers such as Facebook, Google, and Amazon, as well as through enterprise identity providers via SAML 2.0. Amazon Cognito facilitates the integration of social media identity providers (IdPs), making it a suitable choice for the company's mobile app to allow users to sign in through social media.

B. Amazon Cognito. Amazon Cognito is a fully managed identity service that allows you to easily add user sign-up and sign-in to your mobile and web applications. It supports social identity providers (IdPs) such as Facebook, Google, Amazon, and others, allowing users to sign in using their existing social media accounts.

explanation.ja: 正解はB。Amazon Cognitoは、Google・Facebookなどソーシャルメディアの外部IDプロバイダーと連携したユーザーサインイン機能をモバイルアプリに組み込める。AWS Lambdaは関数実行環境、AWS Secrets Managerは認証情報管理、Amazon CloudFrontはCDNであり、ソーシャルログイン連携の実現にはCognitoが適する。

question.en: Which complimentary AWS service or tool creates data-driven business cases for cloud planning?
question.ja: クラウド計画のためのデータ主導のビジネスケースを作成する、無償で利用できるAWSサービスまたはツールはどれですか?

comment.en: Correct

A its correct answer The complimentary AWS service that helps create data-driven business cases for cloud planning is AWS Migration Evaluator, formerly known as TSO Logic. AWS Migration Evaluator assists organizations in understanding the cost-benefits of moving to AWS by analyzing their current on-premises IT infrastructure usage and costs. It provides detailed reports and insights, enabling decision-makers to build compelling, data-driven business cases for cloud migration and planning. This tool helps in identifying the most cost-effective AWS services to meet an organization's specific needs, estimating the potential cost savings, and planning the migration strategy effectively.

explanation.ja: 正解はA。Migration Evaluatorは無償で利用でき、オンプレミス環境の分析に基づきクラウド移行のデータ主導のビジネスケースを作成できる。AWS Billing ConductorとAWS Billingコンソールは請求管理、Amazon Forecastは需要予測サービスであり、移行前のビジネスケース作成には向かない。

question.en: Which cloud concept is demonstrated by using AWS Cost Explorer?
question.ja: AWS Cost Explorerの使用によって示されるクラウドの概念はどれですか?

text.ja: 適切なサイジング(ライトサイジング)

comment.en: A. Rightsizing AWS Cost Explorer is a tool that enables you to visualize, understand, and manage your AWS costs and usage over time. This aligns with the concept of rightsizing, which involves optimizing the allocation of cloud resources based on usage and cost. By using AWS Cost Explorer, you can identify underutilized resources and make informed decisions about adjusting resource allocation to reduce costs, which is a key aspect of rightsizing.

A. Rightsizing. One of the key features of AWS Cost Explorer is rightsizing recommendations, which help users identify opportunities to optimize the cost and performance of their AWS resources by matching resource specifications to actual usage requirements.

explanation.ja: 正解はA。AWS Cost Explorerには利用状況分析に基づくEC2インスタンスのライトサイジング推奨機能があり、適切なサイジングの概念を体現する。信頼性、レジリエンス、モダナイゼーションはCost Explorerが直接示す概念ではなく、コスト分析・最適化という文脈ではライトサイジングが該当する。

question.en:
A company wants to deploy a non-containerized Java-based web application on AWS. The company wants to use a managed service to quickly deploy the application. The company wants the service to automatically provision capacity, load balance, scale, and monitor application health.

Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
question.ja:
ある企業は、コンテナ化されていないJavaベースのWebアプリケーションをAWSにデプロイしたいと考えています。この企業は、アプリケーションを迅速にデプロイするためにマネージドサービスを使用したいと考えています。この企業は、このサービスが容量のプロビジョニング、ロードバランシング、スケーリング、アプリケーションの正常性の監視を自動的に行うことを求めています。

この要件を満たすAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: D. AWS Elastic Beanstalk AWS Elastic Beanstalk is an easy-to-use service for deploying and scaling web applications and services developed with Java, .NET, PHP, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Go, and Docker on familiar servers such as Apache, Nginx, Passenger, and IIS. You simply upload your code, and AWS Elastic Beanstalk automatically handles the deployment, from capacity provisioning, load balancing, and auto-scaling to application health monitoring. It is ideal for non-containerized Java-based web applications, as it abstracts the underlying infrastructure, allowing developers to focus on writing code rather than managing environments
D. AWS Elastic Beanstalk

explanation.ja: 正解はD。AWS Elastic Beanstalkはコンテナ化されていないJavaベースのアプリケーションでも、容量のプロビジョニング、ロードバランシング、スケーリング、正常性監視を自動で行うマネージドサービス。Amazon ECS/EKSはコンテナ化が前提、AWS Lambdaは関数実行が前提であり、コンテナ化されていない従来型Webアプリの迅速なデプロイにはElastic Beanstalkが適する。

question.en: Which AWS service or tool gives users the ability to connect with AWS and deploy resources programmatically?
question.ja: ユーザーがAWSに接続し、プログラムでリソースをデプロイできるようにするAWSサービスまたはツールはどれですか?

comment.en: key word: programmatically*

D. AWS SDKs (Software Development Kits) AWS SDKs provide a set of tools for developers to integrate with and manage AWS services programmatically. These SDKs support multiple programming languages, including Java, Python, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Ruby, and Go, among others, enabling developers to use the language they are most comfortable with to interact with AWS services. Through these SDKs, developers can create, configure, and manage AWS resources directly from their applications.
D. AWS SDKs

explanation.ja: 正解はD。AWS SDKは各種プログラミング言語向けのライブラリで、プログラムによりAWSに接続しリソースをデプロイできる。Amazon QuickSightはBIツール、AWS PrivateLinkはプライベート接続機能、AWS Direct Connectは専用線接続であり、プログラムによるリソースデプロイの実現手段としてはSDKが該当する。

question.en:
A company has deployed a web application to Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances have low usage.

Which AWS service or feature should the company use to rightsize the EC2 instances?
question.ja:
ある企業が、Amazon EC2インスタンスにWebアプリケーションをデプロイしました。このEC2インスタンスの使用率は低い状態です。

EC2インスタンスを適切にサイジングするために企業が使用すべきAWSサービスまたは機能はどれですか?

comment.en: D is correct answer. https://aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/
Optimize Amazon EC2 and Amazon RDS instances with customizable rightsizing recommendations tailored to your workload requirements
AWS Compute Optimizer enables the efficient usage of AWS compute resources for your workloads.
D. AWS Compute Optimizer
D I think.

explanation.ja: 正解はD。AWS Compute Optimizerは実際のリソース使用率を分析し、より適切なEC2インスタンスタイプ・サイズを推奨することで、使用率の低いインスタンスの適正化を支援する。AWS Configは構成管理、AWS Cost Anomaly Detectionは異常検知、AWS Budgetsは予算管理であり、インスタンスサイジングの推奨機能を主目的とするのはCompute Optimizerである。

question.en:
A company wants to define a central data protection policy that works across AWS services for compute, storage, and database resources.

Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
question.ja:
ある企業は、コンピューティング、ストレージ、データベースのリソース向けのAWSサービス全体で機能する、一元化されたデータ保護ポリシーを定義したいと考えています。

この要件を満たすAWSサービスはどれですか?

comment.en: C. AWS Backup AWS Backup is a fully managed backup service that makes it easy to centralize and automate the back up of data across AWS services in the cloud as well as on-premises. With AWS Backup, you can configure backup policies and monitor backup activity for AWS resources in one place. This includes compute resources like EC2 instances, storage resources like EBS volumes, and database resources like RDS databases.
Given Answer is correct
backup

AWS Backup • Fully-managed service to centrally manage and automate backups across AWS services • On-demand and scheduled backups • Supports PITR (Point-in-time Recovery) • Retention Periods, Lifecycle Management, Backup Policies, … • Cross-Region Backup • Cross-Account Backup (using AWS Organizations)
C. AWS Backup

explanation.ja: 正解はC。AWS Backupは、EC2、EBS、RDS、DynamoDB、EFS、FSxなど複数のAWSサービスにまたがるバックアップポリシーを一元的に定義・管理できるサービス。AWS Batchはバッチ処理、AWS Elastic Disaster Recoveryは災害復旧、Amazon FSxはファイルストレージサービスであり、複数サービス横断の一元的なデータ保護ポリシーの定義にはAWS Backupが適する。

question.en:
A company needs to categorize and track AWS usage cost based on business categories.

Which AWS service or feature should the company use to meet these requirements?
question.ja:
ある企業は、ビジネスカテゴリに基づいてAWSの利用コストを分類・追跡する必要があります。

この要件を満たすために企業が使用すべきAWSサービスまたは機能はどれですか?

comment.en: A. Cost allocation tags Cost allocation tags enable you to categorize and track your AWS costs. When you apply tags to your AWS resources (such as EC2 instances or S3 buckets), AWS generates a Cost and Usage Report that includes usage and costs aggregated by tags. This allows you to allocate costs across your organization's business categories, making it easier to track and manage your AWS spending by project, department, application, or any other business-relevant dimension
keyword - categorize = tag
A. Cost allocation tags

explanation.ja: 正解はA。コスト配分タグをリソースに付与することで、ビジネスカテゴリ（部門、プロジェクトなど）ごとにAWS利用コストを分類・追跡できる。AWS Organizationsはアカウント管理、AWS Security Hubはセキュリティ検出結果の集約、AWS Cost and Usage Reportは詳細レポート出力であり、タグによる分類そのものを実現するのはコスト配分タグである。

question.en: Which statements represent the cost-effectiveness of the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)
question.ja: AWSクラウドの費用対効果の高さを表す記述はどれですか？(2つ選択してください。)

text.en: Users can trade fixed expenses for variable expenses.
text.ja: ユーザーは固定費を変動費に置き換えることができる。

text.en: Users can deploy all over the world in minutes.
text.ja: ユーザーは数分で世界中にデプロイできる。

text.en: AWS offers increased speed and agility.
text.ja: AWSはスピードと俊敏性の向上を提供する。

text.en: AWS is responsible for patching the infrastructure.
text.ja: AWSがインフラストラクチャへのパッチ適用を担う。

text.en: Users benefit from economies of scale.
text.ja: ユーザーは規模の経済の恩恵を受ける。

comment.en: A. Users can trade fixed expenses for variable expenses. E. Users benefit from economies of scale.
A&E : cost benefit is the key.
AE, because the D even though is a benefit, the focus of the question is about cost
A. Users can trade fixed expenses for variable expenses. E. Users benefit from economies of scale.
Variable expenses are when you only pay for what you need so you don't pay extra for things you're not using. Economies of scale are what allow for the pay-as-you-go pricing model of AWS
should be DE
I think it must be DE

explanation.ja: 正解はA、E。クラウドでは先行の固定費を実際の使用量に応じた変動費に置き換えられ、また多数の顧客の需要集約による規模の経済の恩恵を受けられるため、費用対効果が高い。数分でのグローバル展開やスピード・俊敏性の向上は別の利点であり、インフラのパッチ適用はコスト面より運用負荷軽減の利点であるため、費用対効果を直接表すのはA、Eである。

question.en:
A company needs to consolidate the billing for multiple AWS accounts. The company needs to use one account to pay on behalf of all the other accounts.

Which AWS service or tool should the company use to meet this requirement?
question.ja:
ある企業は、複数のAWSアカウントの請求を統合する必要があります。この企業は、1つのアカウントで他のすべてのアカウントの分をまとめて支払いたいと考えています。

この要件を満たすために企業が使用すべきAWSサービスまたはツールはどれですか?

comment.en: AWS Organizations allow you to merge accounts into one consolidated bill.

explanation.ja: 正解はB。AWS Organizationsで複数アカウントを1つの組織にまとめ、一括請求（コンソリデーティッドビリング）を有効にすることで、1つの支払いアカウントに請求を統合できる。AWS Trusted Advisorはベストプラクティスチェック、AWS Budgetsは予算管理、AWS Service Catalogはカタログ管理であり、請求統合の仕組みそのものはOrganizationsが担う。

question.en:
A company is moving some of its on-premises IT services to the AWS Cloud. The finance department wants to see the entire bill so it can forecast spending limits.

Which AWS service can the company use to set spending limits and receive notifications if those limits are exceeded?
question.ja:
ある企業が、一部のオンプレミスITサービスをAWSクラウドに移行しています。財務部門は、支出の上限を予測するために請求全体を確認したいと考えています。

支出の上限を設定し、その上限を超えた場合に通知を受け取るために企業が使用できるAWSサービスはどれですか?

text.ja: AWS Organizationsの一括請求(コンソリデーティッドビリング)

comment.en: B. AWS Budgets AWS Budgets is a service that allows users to set customized budgets that track and monitor their AWS spending. Users can set up alerts to be notified via email or SNS when their budget thresholds are approaching or exceeded. This service would allow the finance department to forecast spending limits and receive notifications if those limits are exceeded as requested.
B: AWS Budgets

explanation.ja: 正解はB。AWS Budgetsはコスト・使用量に上限（しきい値）を設定し、超過した場合に通知を送信できる。AWS Cost and Usage Reportsは詳細データの出力、一括請求は請求の統合、Cost Explorerは支出の可視化・分析であり、支出上限の設定と超過通知にはAWS Budgetsが該当する。

question.en: Which AWS Support plans provide access to an AWS technical account manager (TAM)? (Choose two.)
question.ja: AWSテクニカルアカウントマネージャー(TAM)へのアクセスを提供するAWSサポートプランはどれですか？(2つ選択してください。)

comment.en: https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport/plans/
C. AWS Business Support E.AWS Enterprise Support
DE: https://aws.amazon.com/premiumsupport/plans/
D. AWS Enterprise On-Ramp Support E. AWS Enterprise Support
